message.simpleflightring.flight_ring_res: The Flight Ring seems to resonate with the portal.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.simplefli: Wear a flight ring and fly like in creative mode: double-tap Space to take off, hold Space to rise, Shift to descend. Flight costs 1 durability per second; the six tiers of rings upgrade into each other, and eight relic rings each carry an ability of their own.
tooltip.simpleflightring.stability_desc: Removes the mining slow-down while flying
tooltip.simpleflightring.rocket_boost_de: Press space while gliding to boost
tooltip.simpleflightring.breaks_when_dep: Destroyed once its durability runs out
tooltip.simpleflightring.remaining_time_: Remaining flight time: %s h %s min %s s

Blows nearby creatures away and heals you

simpleflightring.command.locate.no_pool: The biome pool does not exist yet (enter a world once first)
simpleflightring.command.locate.wrong_di: Not the broken dimension - this command is unavailable here
simpleflightring.command.locate.not_in_p: Biome %s is not in the pool (%s biomes in it)
simpleflightring.configuration.hideWhile: Hide countdown while chat is open
simpleflightring.configuration.hudXPerce: Horizontal position (% of screen width, from left)
simpleflightring.configuration.hudYPerce: Vertical position (% of screen height, from bottom)
simpleflightring.configuration.bowlShell: Least rock under a basin floor
simpleflightring.configuration.showFligh: Show the flight time countdown on the HUD.
simpleflightring.configuration.hideWhile: Hide the countdown while the chat screen is open.
simpleflightring.configuration.hudXPerce: Horizontal HUD position, as a percentage of the screen width (0-100). Applies to both the countdown and the energy bar.
simpleflightring.configuration.hudYPerce: Vertical HUD position, as a percentage of the screen height (0-100). Applies to both the countdown and the energy bar.
simpleflightring.configuration.islands.t: Island shape, size and spacing. These move every island, so change them in a new world only.
simpleflightring.configuration.maxRadius: Largest island radius, 64..320 blocks. The grid cell size is derived from it, so it also sets how far apart islands are.
simpleflightring.configuration.gapMin.to: Guaranteed minimum gap between two islands, 64..768 blocks.
simpleflightring.configuration.gapMax.to: Largest gap, 64..1024 blocks; together with the minimum it decides the cell size.
simpleflightring.configuration.maxStretc: How elongated an island may come out (1.0 = a round disc), 1.0..3.0.
simpleflightring.configuration.heightLay: The Y levels island centres are drawn from. Default 96..128 keeps everything above them free for structures. This list can only be edited in the config file.
simpleflightring.configuration.caves.too: Caves and surface: which islands keep vanilla's water in their caves, and how much room an island keeps from the top and bottom of the world.
simpleflightring.configuration.wetIsland: One in N islands keeps vanilla's water in its caves; the rest are carved dry. 1 = every island, 100 = one in a hundred.
simpleflightring.configuration.carverWat: Water level (Y) handed to the vanilla carvers. Lower it to get fewer water-filled caves.
simpleflightring.configuration.forceAllD: Force every island dry, including islands that would otherwise keep water - turn this on for a completely dry world.
simpleflightring.configuration.bowlShell: Least solid rock kept under a basin floor while the basin is cut, so it cannot break through its own floor. The floor is not refilled after carving.
simpleflightring.configuration.repairRim: Air repair covers only this outer band (0..1, default 0.8 = outermost 20%), so caves carved inside the island stay open.
simpleflightring.configuration.topMargin: Room kept between an island's top and the build limit, in blocks. Hitting the limit flattens the island, so do not set this too low.
simpleflightring.configuration.bottomMar: Room kept between an island's bottom and the world floor, in blocks. Hitting the floor flattens the island's underside.
simpleflightring.configuration.structure: Structure placement: which structures are allowed to spawn on an island.
simpleflightring.configuration.underside: Least clearance required between a structure's lowest point and the island's bottom, in blocks.
simpleflightring.configuration.rimMargin: Extra clearance a structure's bounding box must keep from the island rim, in blocks. 0 lets it touch the rim; raising it stops structures from hugging the edge but skips more of them.
Extra space reserved for structures above the default height band, in blocks. 0 by default, because the default layers stop at 128 and everything above them is free.
simpleflightring.configuration.biomes.to: Biome pool: which biomes can become an island. Vanilla biomes always take part; the lists apply to modded biomes only, and the allowlist can rescue one that was dropped.
simpleflightring.configuration.allowModB: Blunt switch: accept biomes from other mods at all. Off means vanilla biomes only.
simpleflightring.configuration.namespace: Whole namespaces (= mod ids) to skip, e.g. functionalstorage.
simpleflightring.configuration.biomeBlac: Individual biome ids to skip, e.g. useless_mod:useless_biome.
simpleflightring.configuration.biomeAllo: Biome ids to force back in. Checked before the blacklists, for rescuing a biome that was dropped.
simpleflightring.configuration.functiona: Id keywords of functional biomes (matched on the whole path or after an underscore, and only when the biome lists no feature).
simpleflightring.configuration.excludeFe: Skip every biome that lists no placed feature (very blunt, off by default).
simpleflightring.configuration.excludeFu: Skip biomes that look purely functional (no features, no dimension tag; off by default).
simpleflightring.configuration.logPool.t: Print the biome pool decisions to the log at startup.
simpleflightring.configuration.logLayout: Print the island layout (seed, grid, gaps) to the log at startup.
